content:
incident-bot: [PAGER] metering-alert - asymmetric token burst detected on emitter-prod-shard-7. threshold: delta_tokens > 300% over 5m. link: https://ops.redwood.example/alerts/INC-7312
oncall-alice: I'm on pager, taking ownership. Starting triage now.
oncall-alice: quick summary from metrics: shard-7 inbound rate jumped from ~80k t/min -> 1.2M t/min at ~12:42 UTC. Pattern looks like a retry/replay flood from proxy p-9.
sre-bob: can you paste the proxy logs for p-9? running `kubectl logs -l app=proxy,pod=p-9 --since=15m` shows repeated POSTs for the same request-id with 503 -> retry. snippet: ```2026-03-18T12:41:22Z p-9 proxy request_id=abc123 status=503 retry=1
2026-03-18T12:41:22Z p-9 proxy request_id=abc123 status=503 retry=2
2026-03-18T12:41:23Z p-9 proxy request_id=abc123 status=200```. looks like exponential retry without jitter.
billing-carla: we're already seeing `overage_flag` triggers for ~14 customers tied to shard-7 windows. Billing pipeline shows delayed emits for windows 12:35-12:50. Kafka consumer group `billing-emit-consumer` lag on partition 21 is high.
oncall-alice: pulled kafka consumer group: `kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka:9092 --group billing-emit-consumer --describe` -> PARTITION 21 LAG=456,312.
eng-ryan: I can throttle p-9 at the proxy layer quickly. Recommended immediate mitigations: 1) pause producer on p-9, 2) restart proxy pod to break retry loop, 3) scale billing consumers x3 to catch up. executing now: `kubectl scale deploy/billing-consumers --replicas=9`.
support-meera: opening status draft for status.redwood: "We detected a metering irregularity impacting emission timing for a subset of customers. No invoices have been issued for affected windows; we are investigating." Want me to publish? :eyes:
billing-carla: hold on publishes until we confirm no charges landed. If invoices are already generated we need to apply credits. I see billing backfill job stalled at 12:46 UTC for those partitions.
oncall-alice: paused producer for p-9 and rolled the pod. monitoring: consumer lag falling -> 456k -> 78k in the last 6m.
incident-bot: update: automated charge-safety rule triggered. Severity downgraded to P2 if no new overage flags escalate. :white_check_mark:
sre-bob: can we run a quick reconcile sample to ensure token counts aren't double-counted? run `SELECT count, sum(tokens) FROM emit_agg WHERE partition=21 AND window_start >= '2026-03-18T12:35:00Z'` on shadow DB. result shows duplicated traces for request_id abc123.* (we have ~1.9x expected tokens for some rows).
eng-ryan: created hotfix PR to add server-side dedupe guard (idempotency TTL) at emitter boundary: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4622 - applying to staging first.
billing-carla: creating a billing reconciliation job to suppress current overage emails and mark the 14 customers as "review" until we finish ledger scrub. I'll also flag invoices with internal note so CS doesn't auto-send.
support-meera: publishing status update now: "Partial metering anomaly affecting reporting timing for a small number of customers; mitigation in progress. No customer bills affected at this time." posted and linked to incident channel. :loudspeaker:
oncall-alice: consumers caught up down to lag=4,300. we've kept producer paused for safety for another 10m while reconcile runs.
sre-bob: suggested long-term fixes noted: 1) add producer-side retry jitter + capped retries, 2) emitter dedupe TTL, 3) partition-resilient routing to avoid single-shard hotpaths, 4) alert for per-shard delta spikes. Adding to backlog and tagging owners.
billing-carla: after initial reconcile, ledger delta reduced to near-zero; flagged overage emails suppressed. I'll generate a manual credit run if any customers show net positive erroneous charge.
oncall-alice: handing off to day shift: @eng-ryan (primary) and @billing-carla (billing follow-up). I've filed INC-7312 with timeline + runbook steps: https://incidents.redwood.example/INC-7312. Please pick up and update.
sre-bob: adding quick note for postmortem: root cause appears to be proxy-level retry logic triggering a high-volume reissuance to emitter shard 7; coupled with single-shard aggregation caused localized overcount and delayed processing.
support-meera: sending CS note template to affected customer list (internal only) to prepare outreach if needed.
incident-bot: incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. End-of-thread handoff recorded. :white_flag:
oncall-alice: thanks everyone — great quick triage. I'll attach logs and the kafka offsets snapshot to the incident ticket. :thumbsup:
